conversation_history.user_query: 帮我查一下各个学校的各科score
conversation_history.final_sql: SELECT s.School, sc.AvgScrMath AS Math, sc.AvgScrWrite AS Writing, sc.AvgScrRead AS Reading FROM schools s INNER JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds ORDER BY Math DESC;
